top_band: upper crown of palm fronds (light green/yellow-green radiating from crown center, rows 1-11)
evidence: The palm tree canopy shows an upper crown surface where fronds arch out and downward (rows 1-11) with a bright top highlight at rows 5-6, overhanging and casting shadow (rows 11-13) onto the segmented vertical trunk below (rows 12-39).

style.evidence: The candidate has a uniform 1px pure/near-black outline around the entire silhouette of the fronds and trunk, giving it a strong 'sticker' look compared to the reference trees which use dark green/brown material tones selectively on their edges. The palm fronds and trunk segments are shaded with simple linear bands rather than the rich, organic pixel-cluster texture of the Beodeul trees.
